description: This file defines an email notification class for reporting in the Superset project, including methods for composing and sending emails with embedded data, images, and attachments, as well as handling errors and formatting email content.

classes.name: EmailContent
classes.description: Data class representing the content of an email, including body, header data, data attachments, PDFs, and images.

classes.name: EmailNotification
classes.description: Class responsible for constructing and sending email notifications for reports, with methods for content generation, error handling, and email dispatch.

methods.name: _name
methods.description: Property that returns the notification name, optionally including a date format based on a feature flag.

methods.name: _get_smtp_domain
methods.description: Static method to extract SMTP domain from the configured 'from' email address.

methods.name: _error_template
methods.description: Generates an HTML template for error messages in the email body.

methods.name: _get_content
methods.description: Constructs the email content, including sanitized HTML, embedded images, and attachments.

methods.name: _get_subject
methods.description: Generates the email subject line, including a prefix and the report name.

methods.name: _parse_name
methods.description: Parses the report name to include formatted date if feature flag is enabled.

methods.name: _get_call_to_action
methods.description: Retrieves the call-to-action text for the email.

methods.name: _get_to
methods.description: Retrieves the recipient email target from JSON configuration.

methods.name: _get_cc
methods.description: Retrieves CC targets from JSON configuration, with backward compatibility.

methods.name: _get_bcc
methods.description: Retrieves BCC targets from JSON configuration, with backward compatibility.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the email using SMTP, with error handling and logging.
